# env

## Interfaces

| Interface                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [ExpressEnvSchema](interfaces/ExpressEnvSchema.md) | Environment variables for the `@saflib/express` package, including inherited variables via `extends`. Generated by `@saflib/env`. To update, make changes to the adjacent `env.schema.json`, navigate to the package root, and run `npm exec saf-env generate`. |

## Variables

| Variable                          | Description                                          |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| [typedEnv](variables/typedEnv.md) | `process.env` casted to the `ExpressEnvSchema` type. |
